name: diclofenac + lidocaine
uses: Diclona™ is indicated for relief of pain associated with arthritis, backache, cramps, discomfort, neckache, soreness, sprains, strains. It should be applied only to intact skin. Sun avoidance is indicated during therapy.
contra: Diclona™ is contraindicated in patients with a known history of sensitivity to local anesthetics of the amide type, or to any other component of the product. Diclona Gel is contraindicated in patients with a known hypersensitivity to diclofenac sodium. Diclona Gel is contraindicated in patients in the setting of coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery.
